14.title: fix(reports): text reports render -0.00 for negative values that round to zero

attempts.summary: format_d3 formatted abs(value) then re-attached the sign, so any negative value rounding to zero at the requested precision rendered as -0.00 in report text tables. Ported d3-format's guard (locale.js: drop the sign when the formatted magnitude is zero and the sign mode is not '+') plus a parametrized unit test covering both rounding-to-zero and sign-preserving cases.
attempts.verification:
1) Repro before fix: `.venv/bin/python -c "from superset.utils.number_format import format_number_with_config as f; print(f(',.2f',None,-0.001))"` -> '-0.00'.
2) New test on unpatched source (git stash of superset/utils/number_format.py): `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/utils/number_format_test.py -q -k negative_value_rounding` -> 6 failed, 5 passed.
3) After fix: same command -> 11 passed; full file `pytest tests/unit_tests/utils/number_format_test.py -q` -> 104 passed.
4) Criterion 1 (negative rounding to zero has no sign) and 2 (non-zero keeps sign) verified by `.venv/bin/python -c` matrix: ',.2f' -0.001 -> '0.00'; '.2f' -0.004 -> '0.00'; '$,.2f' -0.001 -> '$0.00'; '(,.2f' -0.001 -> '0.00'; '.1%' -0.0001 -> '0.0%'; 'd' -0.4 -> '0'; ',.2f' -0.005 -> '-0.01'; ',.2f' -1.234 -> '-1.23'; '$,.2f' -1234.5 -> '-$1,234.50'; '(,.2f' -1.234 -> '(1.23)'; '+.2f' -0.001 -> '-0.00' (d3 parity).
5) Regression: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/reports tests/unit_tests/charts -q` -> 589 passed, 2 xfailed.
6) `pre-commit run` on the staged diff -> all hooks Passed (mypy, ruff, ruff-format, pylint).
